purpose: Formal source-faithful original WDSM comparison with generalized matching; this extends the existing32-cell study contract without changing main WM assumptions
sampler: Verbatim original draw_sample; retrospective Bernoulli selection with random realized n; prospective source multistage selection with original allocations
target: Fixed realized source-population potential-outcome PATE/PATT, not a nominal regression coefficient

WM_and_WDSM_common_counts.interpretation: Original WDSM M3 count stream supplied explicitly to every WDSM and WM M value, preserving each procedure's count law while pairing its finite-B comparison
WM_and_WDSM_common_counts.coupling_change_disclosed: Historical driver used a separate stream for each M. This comparison shares its M3 stream across M and model scenarios; it is not a claim of historical M1/M5 finite-B record identity.
WM_and_WDSM_common_counts.source_reference: Use original WDSM routines with the exact same supplied matrix as generalized WM. Save seed, RNG endpoints, matrix and column hashes. No replacement counts after failures.

native_method_bootstrap: Original method-specific seed2000000+100*replicate+10*method_id+M, where seed M=1 for DSM/PGM/PSM and seed M=0 for SWPSM_full (its comparator interface still receives M=1); native nearest-neighbor rows retain M1 and B-1 variance; SWPSM retains full matching and subclass sandwich
tie_seed_rule: Original WDSM3000000+100*replicate+M with original boundary tolerance; modern deterministic ties retained and graph discrepancies explicitly recorded
score_specification: Correct PS/PG includes X1:X2; misspecified excludes it. Original WDSM PS probability weighting retrospective, unit weighting prospective; PG unweighted in both. WM_PS uses the same declared PS fitting convention.

weighted_rows.WDSM_M1_M3_M5: Original independently sourced own-arm two-dimensional scores, correction, random-boundary tie allocation, donor normalization, point estimator and B-divisor fixed-reuse prediction-refit law
weighted_rows.WM_DSM_M1_M3_M5: Independent modern own-arm WDSM stack and self-normalized WM engine; same correction, fitting conventions and count matrix. Compare graphs, points, every draw, B-divisor variance and CI directly against original WDSM.
weighted_rows.WM_PS_M1_M3_M5: Scalar fitted probability coordinate, affine standardization, self-normalized WM; weighted full-X regression correction on the scenario's PG design (main effects, plus interaction when PG is correct). This is explicitly full-X-adjusted PS matching, not score-quadratic-only PSM.
weighted_rows.WM_X6_M1_M3_M5: Six original covariates with pooled divisor-n coordinate standardization and Euclidean metric; weighted complete quadratic full-X correction (28 coefficients), held common across PS/PG specification labels. The full-X basis contains the generating mean interaction.
weighted_rows.WM_DSM_analytic_M1_M3_M5: Separate fitted-stack full-X variance approximation, including nuisance covariance; report empirically in both designs/all scenarios, labeling full-X and iid premises as unverified and often inapplicable. Never substitute this for original refit intervals.

point_output: Retain raw and corrected WM points separately. Historical rows preserve their actual source point corrections, coordinates and metric; unit weights alone do not align different algorithms.
inference: WM counts hold original graph/reuse/weights fixed. DSM refits the complete PS/PG/scaling/quadratic prediction stack. PS and X6 refit their declared full-X outcome regressions; refitting unused PS with a frozen graph would not affect those draws. All B draws required for an interval, divisor B, normal qnorm(.975) limits. Analytic rows remain distinct.
batching: Within one sample/estimand/specification, fit each original/modern prediction stack once per shared count and reuse predictions across M. Do not share failure states between independent families/arms. Native PSM/PGM/SWPSM may reuse calls only when all effective inputs, method seeds and formulas are identical; record that dependency explicitly.
failure_policy: Preserve every planned case/method/count and successful point after interval failure; retain failed count index/hash/warning/solver diagnostics; never drop failed draws, redraw samples, reseed or replace the source method. An original/modern numerical mismatch remains evidence to investigate, not an excluded replicate.

metrics.reference: Unweighted PSM_M1 in CorCor, within the same design/overlap/estimand, shared across all four model scenarios
metrics.relative_bias: 100*(mean estimate - realized population truth)/truth; audited source targets are strictly positive
metrics.relative_efficiency: Reference empirical variance divided by method empirical variance; no replacement by an MSE ratio
metrics.uncertainty: Paired actual sample identities for RE and differences; retain operational coverage, interval availability, failures and conditional-on-success diagnostics separately

scope: Empirical source-design comparison. No cluster/stratum variance theorem or unmeasured-confounding case is introduced. Correct target PS alone is not asserted sufficient for fixed-M self-normalized donor centering; full-X adjustment choices are explicit.
population_input: User-generated or source-matching synthetic populations; historical raw population artifacts are not distributed.
run_status: Exported implementation candidate; direct public entrypoints require separate saved-data integration validation before any execution/replication claim.
